dimensions.name: PREMISE_MATURITY
dimensions.description: Core conflict should match the target reader's autonomy and conceptual range rather than relying on vocabulary to imply maturity.

dimensions.name: NARRATIVE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support layered goals, changing information, reversals, parallel pressures, and earned resolution.

dimensions.name: CONCEPTUAL_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Allow systems, institutions, evidence, ethics, ambiguity, identity, responsibility, and competing explanations at the target level.

dimensions.name: CAUSAL_DEPTH
dimensions.description: Important outcomes should arise from several linked causes, decisions, constraints, and consequences.

dimensions.name: INFERENCE_DEMAND
dimensions.description: Allow meaningful unstated connections and interpretation without making essential causality opaque.

dimensions.name: AGENCY_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: The protagonist should make consequential strategic choices among credible alternatives.

dimensions.name: STAKES_CONSEQUENCE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Stakes may affect reputation, relationships, livelihood, access, identity, institutions, safety, or world state without becoming melodramatic by default.

dimensions.name: SOCIAL_RELATIONSHIP_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support mixed motives, power differences, trust, conflict, loyalty, negotiation, and changing relationships without flattening people into roles.

dimensions.name: PREDICTABILITY_CHALLENGE
dimensions.description: Avoid obvious one-beat solutions; permit wrong models, reversals, incomplete information, and trade-offs.

dimensions.name: WONDER_DISCOVERY
dimensions.description: Adventure-oriented stories should still offer discovery, exploration, systems, mystery, or experiences larger than routine simulation.

dimensions.name: LANGUAGE_READABILITY
dimensions.description: Use clear, natural language appropriate to an independent adult reader; complexity should come from thought and structure, not unnecessary opacity.

required_story_capabilities: A protagonist with a credible age-appropriate role and independent agency
At least one layered objective, unresolved question, or competing priority
Multi-step causality with consequences that accumulate across the episode
A meaningful change in understanding rather than simple clue collection
A consequential choice, strategic trade-off, or irreversible local action
A local episode payoff that does not prematurely close long-horizon questions
Persistent consequence or reusable world-state value when earned
Adventure-oriented modes should include genuine discovery, exploration, mystery, or systems engagement
reject_signals: A premise made to feel older mainly through harder vocabulary
One obvious attempt solves the central problem without meaningful complication
The protagonist mostly observes while another character resolves the core problem
Exposition or lore substitutes for scene-level causality and choice
Mystery or conflict resolves by coincidence, withheld information, or unearned revelation
Violence, trauma, romance, cynicism, or darkness is added merely to signal maturity
The world could be replaced by a generic setting without materially changing the problem
language_rules: Prefer precise natural language over ornamental density
Domain-specific terminology is allowed when it serves action, reasoning, profession, or world logic and remains understandable in context
Do not use vocabulary difficulty as a substitute for premise or conceptual maturity
Let dialogue, action, evidence, and consequence carry interpretation where practical
Avoid juvenile narration unless the exact character voice or scene intentionally calls for it
safety_rules: Maturity does not require graphic violence, sexual content, trauma, or despair
Tension, danger, loss, rivalry, moral uncertainty, and difficult relationships may appear when relevant and proportionate
Do not force age stereotypes, illness, frailty, parenthood, nostalgia, or romance merely because the reader is older
calibration_notes: Age-60 qualification must preserve full conceptual, narrative, and linguistic complexity unless accessibility needs are explicitly requested.
Do not equate age with frailty, cognitive simplification, nostalgia, retirement, illness, or conservative preferences.
Product session length remains separately governed by the cross-age qualification matrix.
Cross-age qualification authority: STANDARD product session is fixed at 1,600–2,500 words for the first controlled 12/18/25/40/60 proof so maturity is isolated from length.

character.name: Selim

character.current_role: expedition coordinator leading a mixed-experience survey team

internal_tensions.side_a: The team expects Selim to have answers.
internal_tensions.side_b: He wants colleagues to challenge his model rather than defer to it.
internal_tensions.description: Leadership can accidentally silence the evidence he needs.

origin.summary: Selim has spent decades coordinating field expeditions and still prefers being outdoors where evidence can surprise him.

formative_events.summary: A younger colleague once disproved one of Selim's long-used field assumptions.
formative_events.impact: He learned to treat correction as part of expertise rather than a threat.

unresolved_questions.question: Why do older field journals omit a seasonal route now visible at Red Cliff?

current_situation.summary: A migratory flock is stopping at Red Cliff weeks earlier than Selim's long-term model predicts, while Derya proposes a habitat explanation that conflicts with his preferred weather explanation.
current_situation.current_role: expedition coordinator leading a mixed-experience survey team
current_situation.current_location_context: Red Cliff Observatory, Salt Meadow transect, and North Blind
current_pressures: the flock may depart by morning
the team has one non-invasive sampling window
current_open_questions: Is the timing shift driven by weather, food availability, or a changed route?
immediate_desires: give Derya room to test her competing interpretation
notes: No age-based physical limitation is assumed; Selim is an active field leader.

relationships.subject: Derya
relationships.trust_or_tension: Derya challenges Selim's weather model with habitat evidence.
known_facts: Selim invited Derya to present competing interpretations.

inventory.name: digitized field journals
story_uses: compare historical timing and route notes

memories.summary: Selim remembers the expedition where a younger colleague overturned his confident model.

world.habitat: windy coastal reserve of red cliffs, salt meadow and tidal flats
world.technology_level: modern ecological field instruments and digital archives
world.summary: The reserve is a living migration corridor where long records are valuable but environmental patterns keep changing.
social_context: seniority carries influence that can distort discussion if unchecked
known_pressures: migration timing is becoming less predictable

known_world_facts: The flock is stopping earlier than Selim's current model predicts.
Derya has habitat observations that support a competing explanation.

main.title: Moving Corridors
main.goal: Understand how the reserve's migration corridor is changing without forcing new evidence into old models.
main.stakes: Bad assumptions can misdirect conservation work and silence useful expertise.
main.central_mystery: Multiple species are shifting timing in ways no single current model explains.

eligible_milestones.summary: Selim's team establishes one bounded observation that changes the balance between weather and habitat explanations.
eligible_milestones.state_condition: A non-invasive comparison produces discriminating evidence.
consequence_options: A bounded follow-up opportunity may become available.

public_long_term_questions.question: What is driving the wider migration timing changes?

opportunities.title: Overnight migration survey
opportunities.summary: The team can compare flock behavior across two habitats before departure.

approved_premise.title: Before the Flock Leaves
approved_premise.logline: With one night before an early migratory flock may leave, Selim must decide how to split the final survey window between his weather-based prediction and Derya's habitat hypothesis, knowing his authority can shape what the team notices.
approved_premise.protagonist_role: Selim remains physically and intellectually active while his most consequential leadership choice is how he uses expertise under uncertainty.
approved_premise.immediate_objective: Collect evidence that genuinely discriminates between the weather and habitat explanations before the flock departs.
approved_premise.inciting_event: The flock abandons a historically reliable cliff perch and settles near an unusually productive salt meadow.
approved_premise.central_problem: Selim's long record supports one explanation while current habitat evidence supports another, and the team cannot fully test both before morning.
approved_premise.wonder_or_discovery: A familiar migration route behaves differently enough to make decades of observation a starting point rather than an answer.
approved_premise.stakes: The team's recommendation will shape future survey effort and professional trust; overconfidence can waste a season of conservation work.
constraints: One night cannot establish the full regional cause.
approved_premise.meaningful_choice_pressure: Selim must choose how to allocate the last sampling window and whether to prioritize his own forecast or a test designed around Derya's competing model.
approved_premise.mystery_or_forward_question: Is Red Cliff an isolated shift or part of a wider moving corridor?
approved_premise.local_payoff: Earn a meaningful change in the team's working model and relationship, while preserving the larger ecological question.
persistent_outcomes_possible: Trust between Selim and Derya may deepen or strain.
A follow-up corridor study may become justified.

creation_constraints: Ecological claims must remain bounded by observed evidence.
forbidden_creations: Sudden illness or nostalgia used to manufacture maturity
Complete regional answer from one night

authority_rules: Spine may use only facts, states, permissions and questions present in this pack.
A model may invent transient scene texture but not durable canon unless creative_permission_envelope permits it.
Hidden truth answers are absent from this pack and must not be inferred as fact.
RUMORED locations are foreshadow-only; locked/limited locations obey their premise_usage.
Only eligible milestones may be targeted, and a spine cannot itself commit completion.
Inventory capability must come from inventory entries or explicit world/character authority.
Relationships may evolve only through earned episode actions; starting state remains authoritative.
Persistent outcomes remain candidates until delivered prose and post-story commit earn them.
hard_freezes: One night cannot establish the full regional cause.
Earn a meaningful change in the team's working model and relationship, while preserving the larger ecological question.
Do not reveal or assert hidden Saga answers absent from this pack.
